title: Homeowners who may lack a homestead exemption
subtitle: Estimates by county, in households
alt: Bar chart of homeowners who may be eligible for the Texas homestead exemption but are not claiming it, from The Texas Tribune: about 113,000 in Harris County, about 60,000 each in Travis and Bexar counties, and 57,000 in Dallas County. In Travis County that is about 1 in 5 households.
